BiblicalUsage: Energeia is working in power — energy at work. There is the working of Satan with all power and lying wonders in 2 Thessalonians 2:9, and there is the working of God's mighty power in us in Ephesians 1:19. Paul labours striving according to His working which works in him mightily in Colossians 1:29, and Christ will change our bodies according to the working by which He subdues all things in Philippians 3:21.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe there are only two energies at work in the world — God's and the enemy's — and they are not equal. I hold that the same power that raised Christ is working in me right now, and that is why I can labour without burning out: it is His working, not mine.
